Messages.Author: Uriel
Messages.Body:
1. Can vampires in torpor use Action Modifiers (e.g. for stealth when
leaving torpor)?

2. Can other vampires modify a self-rescue attempt with Mask of 1000
Faces or Blanket of Night?

Thanks for the help

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <e8b60e8d.01062...@posting.google.com>,

Uriel <galama...@hotmail.com> wrote:
>1. Can vampires in torpor use Action Modifiers (e.g. for stealth when
>leaving torpor)?

Yes. You could even Day Operation your own leave torpor action, for
MAXIMUM POINTLESSNESS! But, yes, playing Lost in Crowds on your
own leave torpor attempt is perfectly legit.

>2. Can other vampires modify a self-rescue attempt with Mask of 1000
>Faces or Blanket of Night?

Depends on the card. Blanket or Cloak are legit, since they're usable
by a ready non-acting minion to give an acting minion +1 stealth (or
to affect a would-be blocking minion, in Blanket's case),
but Mask is not OK since the Masking minion (being ready, as required
by Mask's card text) is not legally able to take the action (rescue self
from torpor).

If they were both in torpor, and Mask didn't specify a ready minion,
you could mask the rescue action from one to the other, but as it
stands, no.

gomi

Messages.Author: TigToad

>
> Yes. You could even Day Operation your own leave torpor action, for
> MAXIMUM POINTLESSNESS! But, yes, playing Lost in Crowds on your
> own leave torpor attempt is perfectly legit.

Actually, I have a fortitude/protean force of will day op bleed/torpor
deck.. that uses regenerations and freak drives along with minion taps.
Lots of parts but a lot of fun to play. Anyway, to avoid being
diablerized I have day-oped a rescue attempt (when the vampire was
trying to self rescue) to make it unblockable. Then another vampire,
preferably with more stealth would be able to go do the rescue action.
Granted not often useful, but I have done it and felt it was the right
thing to do.

Though, playing Kiss or Ra on a leave torpor action is just so much more
fun.

Tig

> 1. Can vampires in torpor use Action Modifiers (e.g. for stealth when

Yes, so long as he's the acting vampire. [6.5.1]

> 2. Can other vampires modify a self-rescue attempt with Mask of 1000
> Faces or Blanket of Night?

Blanket of Night, yes. Mask1K, no, since he's not capable of taking
that action.

Correct. Vampires in torpor can only play action modifiers when acting -
they cannot modify the actions of other minions.
